quests.title: Three Houses and a Rumour
quests.summary: Pass a rumour from Carlisle to Keswick, hear what Lancaster makes of it, and report back.

steps.line: That old tale? It's true, but half of it, and the dull half. Ask over in Lancaster, they'll tell you the rest.
Oh, that. It was a swan, in the end. It's always a swan. Tell them it was a swan.
A swan! I said it was a swan! Nobody listens. Here, you listened.

start.ask: Aye, I've heard something about Keswick, but I'd like it confirmed. Would you ask round? Pass it on gently.
start.accept: Lovely. Whatever they say, I knew it already.

quests.title: A Card by Hand
quests.summary: Take a birthday card to Carlisle in time, since the post is no use, and hear how it landed.

steps.line: A card! In this weather! Tell them I'm touched, and that they still can't spell my name.

steps.text: Take the reply back to Keswick.
steps.line: She said that? Ha. Right, I'll write back. Meanwhile, this is for you.

start.ask: Aye, it's a birthday card for my old mate in Carlisle, and the post would take a fortnight. Would you hand it over?
start.accept: Tell her it's from the best-looking person in Keswick. She'll know it's me.
